preambles.trail: This is a read-only research task over the record ledger under bench/batching2/fixtures/ledger/ in this repository. Do not modify, create or delete any file. Each record is one small file with a `record:` line naming its id, an `amount-code:` line, and a `refers-to:` line naming the id of another record; the files are spread over many directories and their names do not say which record they hold. The numbered items below are a trail: item 1 names the starting record, and each later item is the record that the previous item's record refers to. For each item, report one line: the record id, its amount-code, and the path of its file relative to the repository root. Answer from the record files themselves.

nudge: The devcouncil_script tool runs a short Starlark program whose calls are the read-only lookup tools, so a lookup that depends on the previous answer can be chained inside one devcouncil_script call instead of costing a step each. Prefer devcouncil_script for lookups that depend on each other.
